diagnosis: Account is limited to 90 days of audit log retention under the standard tier; longer retention (400 days) is a premium feature not present in the account's entitlements. Export via NDJSON is available for the retained window.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. On your current plan, audit log entries are retained for 90 days; longer retention (400 days) is available on a higher plan tier. Within that 90-day window, you can export your audit log as NDJSON through the audit endpoint, which may help your compliance team work with the data. Let us know if you'd like more details on the export process.
